Keeper review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: A solid choice with built-in Emergency Access: name trusted contacts who can request your vault after a wait period. Best for: People who want emergency access alongside business-grade security features.

Key facts

  • Category: Vaults & password managers
  • Pricing: Paid plans with a free trial. Check current pricing.
  • Best for: People who want emergency access alongside business-grade security features.
  • Up to 5 emergency contacts, each with an optional access delay of up to 3 months
  • Mature apps on every platform

Official site / docs ↗

What are the pros and cons of Keeper?

Pros

  • Up to 5 emergency contacts, each with an optional access delay of up to 3 months
  • Mature apps on every platform
  • Extra add-ons for secure file storage

Cons

  • Add-ons can increase the total cost
  • Contacts need a Keeper account to accept access
  • Emergency Access is for consumer accounts only, not business accounts

What are similar tools?

Vaults & password managers

Bitwarden

The best-value password manager with real emergency access: trusted contacts can request View or Takeover access after a wait time you set.

Vaults & password managers

1Password

Excellent password manager, but it has no automatic emergency-access feature. Legacy planning relies on the Emergency Kit and family account recovery.

Vaults & password managers

LastPass Emergency Access

It works: contacts can request vault access after a wait period. LastPass's 2022 security breaches are a good reason to look at alternatives first, though.
